stem:
Ojas compares camels on a hot dry plain with yaks on a snowy high ridge.

Why do the animals in the two regions differ?

options.text: The plain and the ridge have different conditions, so different animals live there.
Different regions always have different animals, even when their conditions are the same.
The plain is hot and dry because camels live there.
No kind of animal can live on both a hot dry plain and a snowy ridge.

teacher.key_rationale: Animals differ across regions because conditions such as heat, dryness, and snowfall differ. Regions need not differ when conditions match; camels do not cause the plain's climate; some animals can live in more than one kind of place.
